AllowGrenadesThroughShields.label: Allow Grenades Through Shields
AllowGrenadesThroughShields.description: Allows grenades to pass through shield bubbles.

SafeRestLocation.label: Safe Rest Location
SafeRestLocation.description: Pawns (including animals) will only rest/sleep in safe locations without hazards like fire, pollution, or gas. They'll also avoid doors.

TargetMarkEnhancement.label: Spotter Mark Enhancement
TargetMarkEnhancement.description: Artillery and mortars will prioritize firing at targets marked by the spotters. Other turrets gain a small accuracy boost when firing at marked targets.

AutoTargetMarksOnNonHostile.label: Auto Target Marks on Non-Hostile Entities
AutoTargetMarksOnNonHostile.description: Whether artillery and mortars should automatically target spotter marks on non-hostile entities (e.g., neutral animals or visitors).
